notes.title: Update 2.5
notes.content:
- Blastcooldown set from 2 to 5 seconds (felt too strong)
- Master Achievement score required set from 80000 to 60000
- Teslagun now deals 15 instead of 10 damage 
- Cooldowns are now displayed on the HUD 
- Visual improvement of the lights when recharging players utility charge
- Updated visuals when hit by an attack

Thanks for playing
Lukas Strobel

notes.title: Update 2.4
notes.content:
- Changed some things in the first Level to make it a little bit easier.

The Arena will be postboned some days, i have too much to do...

notes.title: Update 2.3
notes.content:
- Tutorial reworked (Replay it if you dont know some of the abilities you can use)
- Added button to get help if you cant proceed in a level
- You can find my Email adress on the Molten Metal screen in the HUB to send me infos about Bugs (if you find any, i really appreciate the help)

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
New small update in 1-2 days:

Tutorial Improvements --> It will show some tactics so players will get to know some of the abilites better.
Level 1 rework upcoming --> Make it more exciting

Arena Level for fighting off waves of enemies to unlock a new achievement and a new ability (maybe in 4 days)

A new window for sending me ideas for improvement and bugs you found.

Thank you all for playing!!
